acceptance: diagnostic observations only; not P50 measurements and not additional gate samples

execution.timing_scope: existing ready-source-to-Arrow timer plus job-owned Join CPU trace

cases.finding: retain_threshold returns i128::MAX when the opposite ingress has Ended, making every current row retain=false. prepare_hot_input requires every row to be retained, so the entire 1M-row quote batch incorrectly falls back to RunCore instead of using the previous hot path.

The native BandJoin still executes, so this is not a RunCore fallback. prepare_hot_input adds hot_batch_charge with production KeyStore routing for both 1M-row sides. The uncovered region includes that new charge and other uninstrumented runtime work; no separate hot_charge timer was present, so the exact per-function attribution is not claimed.
